title: Cylinder
spec: Create a new coordinate system by setting the Euler angles to negative ninety, zero, and negative ninety degrees, and set the translation vector to zero, zero, and zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch by creating a new face and drawing a closed loop consisting of four lines. The first line starts at zero, zero and ends at zero point zero six five six, zero. The second line starts at zero point zero six five six, zero and ends at zero point zero six five six, zero point zero one six one. The third line starts at zero point zero six five six, zero point zero one six one and ends at zero, zero point zero one six one. The fourth line starts at zero, zero point zero one six one and ends at zero, zero. Apply a scaling factor of zero point zero six five six to the sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles negative ninety, zero, and negative ninety degrees, and translating it using the translation vector zero, zero, and zero. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by zero point seven five units, ensuring not to extrude in the opposite direction, and create a new solid body. Name this shape "Cylinder". It has a rectangular top and a circular base, with the top being slightly wider than the base. The length of the cylinder is zero point zero six five six units, the width is zero point zero one six one units, and the height is zero point seven five units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0656, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0656, 0.0161) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0161) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90, 0, -90) and the translation vector is (0, 0, 0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the model 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0656) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0656) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular bar
r = r.extrude(0.0161)
